jobs.title: Assistant Director – Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Review global benchmarks in public borrowing strategies, operational processes, and debt management frameworks for developing action plans for improvements in existing debt management operations.
Ensure effective coordination in the development and implementation of overall DMO strategy, budget, development and training needs for the relevant teams.
Assist the Director Operations / COO in ensuring that DMO Operations are running smoothly, addressing any risk/compliance related issue immediately with appropriate risk mitigation steps, and holding of periodic meetings of relevant Domestic Debt, Cash Management, Debt Coordination Committees.
Develop and maintain effective coordination with all relevant stakeholders including other Wings within MoF, EAD and the State Bank of Pakistan to ensure effective and timely compliance with all statutory and other reporting obligations such as budgets, projections, Debt Bulletins, Debt Sustainability Analysis reviews, and Debt Policy Statement, etc.
To coordinate with relevant teams within DMO, Wings of MoF, EAD and SBP for the development, review and implementation of Medium-Term Debt Management Strategy to achieve desired composition of debt portfolio in relation to cost-risk trade-off
Responsible for monitoring and reporting the timely execution of all new initiatives, projects related to DMO operations.
Oversee and coordinate matters related to Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs), government guarantees, and contingent liabilities, including their assessment, monitoring, reporting, and integration into the overall debt and risk management framework.
Coordinate the preparation of responses to National Assembly and Senate questions, attend relevant parliamentary sessions and meetings of Senate and National Assembly Standing Committees, and provide technical input on debt-related matters, in consultation with the Directors of External Debt and Domestic Debt.
Prepare governance guidelines for the Debt Management Office for approval by the competent authorities.

jobs.title: Director Operations
jobs.description:
Ensure effective operational excellence in all aspects of Debt Management Office operations i.e.
o Governance framework implementation,
o Debt recording and servicing payments,
o Legal documentation e.g. ISDAs, Loan Contracts, Guarantee Agreements etc
o Operational & Fraud/compliance Risks which lead to reputation damage and/or financial loss to the GOP,
o HR (in consultation with DG Debt/Advisor Debt),
o IT – Data Security and Back-ups and
o Audit facilitation as approved by Finance Secretary, DG Debt, and Advisor Debt
Drive continuous improvement and prepare global benchmarks in public borrowing strategies, operational processes, and debt management frameworks.
Provide inputs in the overall DMO strategy, in developing budgets and in setting development and training expectations for teams.
Hold regular meetings with other direct reports of the DG Debt/Advisor Debt to ensure that Operations are running smoothly and that any risk/compliance issue highlighted is addressed immediately with additional safeguards of risk controls to minimize possibility of repetition.
Institutionalize coordination with other teams within MoF, EAD and the State Bank of Pakistan to ensure effective and timely compliance with all statutory and other reporting obligations such as budgets, projections, debt bulletins, debt sustainability reviews, and annual statements.
Responsible for timely execution of all Audit and IT projects.
Facilitate and actively participate in Domestic Borrowing Committee and Cash Management meetings in consultation with other Directors, and coordinate periodic meetings of the Debt Coordination Committee in consultation with the Finance Secretary, DG Debt, and the Advisor Debt.
Perform other tasks as delegated by the DG Debt / Advisor Debt or required under the Fiscal Responsibility and Debt Limitation Act, 2005.
Educational Qualification:
Minimum 16 years of education / Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Public Policy or a related field from an HEC-recognized or internationally reputable institution; OR
Any one of the following professional qualifications:
o Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) Charter-holder
o Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan (FCA)
o FRM
Experience Requirement:
Minimum 12 years of relevant professional experience in public debt management, treasury, or financial / capital markets.

jobs.title: Director General
jobs.description:
Strategic Leadership & Governance
Formulate and execute CDNS's multi-year strategic plan aligned with the DMO’s, Medium Term Debt Strategy and FRDL Act(as amended from time to time).
Serve as the Director General and administrative head of CDNS, responsible for overall institutional performance.
Serve as a member of the Steering Committee to Review Implementation of Strategic Realignment of CDNS and present strategic plans for consultation, discussion and implementation of key decisions of the Steering Committee.
Provide strategic oversight of all functional directorates: HR, Operations, Legal, Audit & Inspection, Product Development & Management and any other CDNS directorates.
Propose creation and restructuring of organizational units to improve efficiency and service delivery.
Define, assign, and periodically review job descriptions for all posts of CDNS.
Financial Management & Budgetary Oversight
Exercise sanctioning authority over expenditures in accordance with powers conferred under General Financial Rules (GFR).
Lead the preparation and submission of proposals for the administrative budget to Finance Division through the CF&AO.
Submit proposals on investment, repayment, and interest budgets to Finance Division.
Drive the achievement of assigned budgetary investment targets.
Propose revisions to rates of return on national savings schemes based on macroeconomic and market analysis.
Product Development & Scheme Management
Lead the design and launch of new savings instruments and products.
Work actively with the Director, Domestic Debt, DMO, on product pricing and product launch to align CDNS’s funding with overall MTDS.
Oversee NSS rules and any amendments thereof.
Monitor performance of existing savings schemes and recommend modifications to enhance investor appeal and fiscal efficiency.
Human Resource Management
Function as appointing authority for employees in BPS 3–16.
Exercise disciplinary authority over employees in BPS 3–16 under the E&D Rules.
Manage all HR matters for BPS 17–19 officers (excluding appointment and disciplinary cases reserved for the competent authority).
Drive a culture of meritocracy, accountability, and continuous professional development across CDNS.
Initiate talent development programs and succession planning for leadership roles.
Digital Transformation & Technology
Lead CDNS's digital transformation agenda, including the development and rollout of online savings platforms and mobile banking interfaces.
